summary_en: Ilemela's staple grain crop, grown mainly in the short and long rains.
summary_sw: Zao kuu la nafaka Ilemela, hulimwa hasa msimu wa vuli na masika.

stages.text_en: Clear the field early, plough to 20-25cm depth, and apply well-rotted manure or compost 2-3 weeks before planting to build soil fertility around Ilemela's sandy-loam soils.
stages.text_sw: Safisha shamba mapema, lima kina cha sm 20-25, na weka samadi iliyooza vizuri wiki 2-3 kabla ya kupanda ili kuboresha rutuba ya udongo wa kichanga wa Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Plant certified seed at the onset of reliable rains, spacing 75cm between rows and 25cm between plants, 2 seeds per hole at 5cm depth.
stages.text_sw: Panda mbegu bora mvua zinapoanza kunyesha kwa uhakika, nafasi ya sm 75 kati ya mistari na sm 25 kati ya mimea, mbegu 2 kwa shimo, kina cha sm 5.

stages.text_en: Weed at 2 and 5 weeks, top-dress with nitrogen fertiliser at knee height, and scout weekly for fall armyworm - a major threat in Mwanza region.
stages.text_sw: Palilia wiki ya 2 na ya 5, weka mbolea ya nitrojeni mmea ukifika goti, na kagua kila wiki dhidi ya kiwavijeshi vamizi anayesumbua sana mkoa wa Mwanza.

stages.text_en: Harvest when husks turn brown and grain is hard, usually 3.5-4 months after planting. Dry to below 13% moisture before storage.
stages.text_sw: Vuna makapi yakiwa ya kahawia na punje kuwa ngumu, kawaida miezi 3.5-4 baada ya kupanda. Kausha hadi unyevu chini ya asilimia 13 kabla ya kuhifadhi.

stages.text_en: Store in hermetic (PICS) bags to avoid weevil losses, and check DAES market prices before selling to time your sale for the best price.
stages.text_sw: Hifadhi kwa magunia ya PICS kuepuka hasara ya vidudu, na angalia bei za soko kwenye DAES kabla ya kuuza ili kupata bei nzuri.

summary_en: A quick-maturing legume often intercropped with maize around Ilemela.
summary_sw: Zao la jamii ya kunde linalokomaa haraka, mara nyingi hupandwa kwa mseto na mahindi Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Prepare a fine seedbed with light tillage; beans dislike waterlogged soil, so ensure good drainage.
stages.text_sw: Andaa shamba lenye udongo laini kwa kulima kidogo; maharage hayapendi udongo unaotuama maji, hakikisha maji yanapita vizuri.

stages.text_en: Sow at the start of rains, 20cm between plants and 40cm between rows, 1 seed per hole at 3-4cm depth.
stages.text_sw: Panda mvua zinapoanza, sm 20 kati ya mimea na sm 40 kati ya mistari, mbegu 1 kwa shimo, kina cha sm 3-4.

stages.text_en: Weed once at 2-3 weeks; watch for bean fly at seedling stage and aphids during flowering.
stages.text_sw: Palilia mara moja wiki ya 2-3; angalia inzi wa maharage awamu ya miche na vidukari wakati wa kuchanua.

stages.text_en: Ready in 60-90 days when pods dry and rattle. Harvest before pods shatter to avoid seed loss.
stages.text_sw: Huwa tayari siku 60-90 maganda yakikauka na kutoa mlio. Vuna kabla maganda hayajapasuka ili kuepuka hasara ya mbegu.

stages.text_en: Sun-dry thoroughly before storage to prevent mould, and compare Mwanza market prices on DAES before selling in bulk.
stages.text_sw: Kausha vizuri kwa jua kabla ya kuhifadhi ili kuepuka ukungu, na linganisha bei za soko la Mwanza kwenye DAES kabla ya kuuza kwa jumla.

summary_en: Grown in the lower, moisture-retentive plots around Ilemela's wetlands.
summary_sw: Hulimwa katika maeneo tambarare yenye unyevu karibu na maeneo oevu ya Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Plough and puddle the paddy while wet, levelling the field so water stands evenly across the plot.
stages.text_sw: Lima na chovya udongo ukiwa na maji, sawazisha shamba ili maji yatuame sawasawa.

stages.text_en: Raise seedlings in a nursery for 21-25 days, then transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill, 20x20cm spacing.
stages.text_sw: Otesha miche kitaluni kwa siku 21-25, kisha hamishia shambani miche 2-3 kwa kichuguu, nafasi ya sm 20x20.

stages.text_en: Maintain 5cm standing water, weed by hand at 3 weeks, and monitor for stem borer and rice blast disease.
stages.text_sw: Dumisha maji ya sm 5, palilia kwa mkono wiki ya 3, na fuatilia funza wa shina na ugonjwa wa blast.

stages.text_en: Harvest at 3.5-4.5 months when 80-90% of grains turn golden, and drain the field a week before cutting.
stages.text_sw: Vuna miezi 3.5-4.5 asilimia 80-90 ya punje zikiwa za rangi ya dhahabu, toa maji shambani wiki moja kabla ya kukata.

stages.text_en: Dry to 14% moisture, consider milling locally to sell as rice rather than paddy for a better margin.
stages.text_sw: Kausha hadi unyevu asilimia 14, fikiria kusaga hapo hapo ili kuuza mchele badala ya mpunga kwa faida zaidi.

summary_en: A high-value vegetable widely grown near Ilemela for the Mwanza urban market.
summary_sw: Zao la mboga lenye thamani kubwa linalolimwa sana Ilemela kwa soko la mjini Mwanza.

stages.text_en: Deep-plough and add compost; raise beds if the plot is heavy to improve drainage.
stages.text_sw: Lima kwa kina na weka mboji; tengeneza matuta kama shamba lina udongo mzito ili maji yapite vizuri.

stages.text_en: Raise seedlings in a nursery for 4 weeks, then transplant at 60x45cm spacing in the evening or on a cloudy day.
stages.text_sw: Otesha miche kitaluni kwa wiki 4, kisha hamishia shambani nafasi ya sm 60x45 wakati wa jioni au siku ya mawingu.

stages.text_en: Stake plants, remove suckers, water consistently, and scout for tuta absoluta leaf miner and blight.
stages.text_sw: Weka miti ya kutegemeza, ondoa machipukizi ya ziada, mwagilia maji mara kwa mara, na kagua nondo wa tuta absoluta na ugonjwa wa baka.

stages.text_en: Pick at breaker to light-red stage every 2-3 days over an 8-10 week harvesting window.
stages.text_sw: Chuma zikiwa zianza kuiva hadi rangi nyekundu hafifu kila siku 2-3 kwa muda wa wiki 8-10 za mavuno.

stages.text_en: Handle gently to avoid bruising, grade by size, and sell quickly since tomatoes are highly perishable.
stages.text_sw: Shughulikia kwa uangalifu kuepuka michubuko, panga kwa ukubwa, na uza haraka kwani nyanya huharibika upesi.

summary_en: A fast-growing leafy vegetable, popular for quick income around Ilemela.
summary_sw: Mboga ya majani inayokua haraka, maarufu kwa kipato cha haraka Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Prepare fine, well-drained beds enriched with manure; mchicha grows best in fertile, moist soil.
stages.text_sw: Andaa matuta laini yenye mifereji mizuri na samadi ya kutosha; mchicha hukua vizuri kwenye udongo wenye rutuba na unyevu.

stages.text_en: Broadcast or drill seed in rows 20cm apart, cover lightly, and water immediately after sowing.
stages.text_sw: Sambaza au panda kwa mistari yenye nafasi ya sm 20, funika kidogo, na mwagilia maji mara moja baada ya kupanda.

stages.text_en: Water daily in dry weather, thin overcrowded seedlings, and watch for aphids and leaf-eating caterpillars.
stages.text_sw: Mwagilia kila siku wakati wa ukame, punguza miche iliyosongamana, na angalia vidukari na viwavi wanaokula majani.

stages.text_en: Start cutting leaves 3-4 weeks after planting; repeated harvests are possible over several weeks.
stages.text_sw: Anza kuvuna majani wiki 3-4 baada ya kupanda; unaweza kuvuna mara kadhaa kwa wiki kadhaa zijazo.

stages.text_en: Sell fresh within a day of harvest as leaves wilt fast; bundle uniformly for easier pricing.
stages.text_sw: Uza ukiwa mbichi ndani ya siku moja baada ya kuvuna kwani majani hunyauka haraka; funga vishada sawa kwa bei rahisi.

summary_en: Kept for milk, meat and manure by many households around Ilemela.
summary_sw: Hufugwa kwa ajili ya maziwa, nyama na samadi na kaya nyingi Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Build a well-ventilated, dry shed with a sloped floor for easy cleaning and manure collection.
stages.text_sw: Jenga banda lenye hewa ya kutosha, kavu, na sakafu yenye mteremko kwa usafi rahisi na ukusanyaji wa samadi.

stages.text_en: Buy from a reputable source, check vaccination records, and quarantine new animals for two weeks.
stages.text_sw: Nunua kutoka chanzo kinachoaminika, angalia rekodi za chanjo, na tenga mnyama mpya kwa wiki mbili.

stages.text_en: Provide clean water, quality forage and mineral supplements, and follow a deworming and vaccination schedule against East Coast fever and foot-and-mouth disease.
stages.text_sw: Toa maji safi, malisho bora na madini ya kuongeza, na fuata ratiba ya kutoa minyoo na chanjo dhidi ya homa ya pwani ya mashariki na ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.

stages.text_en: Milk twice daily at fixed times for dairy animals, and track weight gain for animals being raised for beef.
stages.text_sw: Kamua mara mbili kwa siku kwa nyakati maalum kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa, na fuatilia ongezeko la uzito kwa wale wa nyama.

stages.text_en: Check DAES livestock prices, and transport animals early in the cool morning to reduce stress and weight loss.
stages.text_sw: Angalia bei za mifugo kwenye DAES, na safirisha mifugo asubuhi na mapema wakati wa baridi kupunguza msongo na kupungua uzito.

summary_en: A common, low-capital enterprise for households across Ilemela.
summary_sw: Ufugaji wenye mtaji mdogo unaofugwa sana na kaya za Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Build a predator-proof, well-ventilated coop with enough space per bird and easy-to-clean litter.
stages.text_sw: Jenga banda lisiloingiliwa na wanyama wakali, lenye hewa ya kutosha na nafasi ya kutosha kwa kila kuku, na matandiko rahisi kusafisha.

stages.text_en: Source day-old chicks or fertile eggs from a trusted hatchery, and keep a brooder at 32-35°C for the first week.
stages.text_sw: Pata vifaranga wa siku moja au mayai bora kutoka chanzo kinachoaminika, na weka chekecheke lenye joto la 32-35°C wiki ya kwanza.

stages.text_en: Feed age-appropriate rations (starter, grower, layer/finisher), provide clean water always, and vaccinate against Newcastle disease and fowl typhoid.
stages.text_sw: Lisha chakula kinachoendana na umri (starter, grower, layer/finisher), toa maji safi kila mara, na chanja dhidi ya mdondo na typhoid ya kuku.

stages.text_en: Collect eggs at least twice daily for layers, and monitor daily weight gain for broilers to plan sale timing.
stages.text_sw: Kusanya mayai mara mbili kwa siku kwa kuku wa mayai, na fuatilia ongezeko la uzito kila siku kwa broiler kupanga muda wa kuuza.

stages.text_en: Sell broilers at 6-8 weeks when demand peaks (holidays, weekends), and track DAES market prices for the best rate.
stages.text_sw: Uza broiler wiki 6-8 mahitaji yanapokuwa juu (sikukuu, wikendi), na fuatilia bei za DAES kupata bei nzuri zaidi.

summary_en: A fast-growing meat enterprise popular with youth groups near Ilemela.
summary_sw: Ufugaji wa nyama unaokua haraka, maarufu kwa vikundi vya vijana karibu na Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Build a concrete-floored sty with good drainage and shade, allowing at least 1-1.5 sqm per growing pig.
stages.text_sw: Jenga banda lenye sakafu ya zege na mifereji mizuri na kivuli, ukiwa na nafasi ya angalau mita za mraba 1-1.5 kwa nguruwe mmoja.

stages.text_en: Buy weaners of about 8-10kg from a healthy source and quarantine before mixing with existing stock.
stages.text_sw: Nunua nguruwe wa kunyonya wenye kilo 8-10 kutoka chanzo chenye afya na tenga kabla ya kuchanganya na waliopo.

stages.text_en: Feed a balanced ration of maize bran, sunflower cake and greens, provide constant clean water, and deworm regularly.
stages.text_sw: Lisha chakula bora cha pumba za mahindi, mashudu ya alizeti na majani, toa maji safi kila mara, na toa minyoo mara kwa mara.

stages.text_en: Weigh monthly if possible and separate aggressive feeders to ensure even growth across the group.
stages.text_sw: Pima uzito kila mwezi kama inawezekana na tenganisha wanaokula kwa ukali ili wote wakue sawasawa.

stages.text_en: Pigs reach market weight (70-90kg) in about 5-6 months; check DAES prices before agreeing a sale.
stages.text_sw: Nguruwe hufikia uzito wa soko (kilo 70-90) baada ya miezi 5-6; angalia bei za DAES kabla ya kukubaliana bei ya kuuza.

summary_en: A hardy, low-maintenance animal well suited to Ilemela's drier plots.
summary_sw: Mnyama imara asiyehitaji utunzaji mkubwa, anayefaa maeneo makavu ya Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Build a raised, slatted-floor shed to keep goats dry and reduce parasite build-up.
stages.text_sw: Jenga banda lililoinuka lenye sakafu ya mbao zenye mianya ili mbuzi wakae kavu na kupunguza minyoo.

stages.text_en: Select healthy does and bucks with good body condition, and quarantine new animals for two weeks.
stages.text_sw: Chagua mbuzi jike na dume wenye afya na umbo zuri, na tenga wapya kwa wiki mbili.

stages.text_en: Allow browsing plus supplementary fodder and mineral licks, and deworm every 2-3 months.
stages.text_sw: Ruhusu kulisha kwa kuchunga na kuongeza malisho na mawe ya madini, na toa minyoo kila miezi 2-3.

stages.text_en: Breed does from 8 months at a healthy weight; gestation is about 5 months, usually giving twins.
stages.text_sw: Zalisha jike kuanzia miezi 8 akiwa na uzito mzuri; ujauzito ni takribani miezi 5, mara nyingi huzaa mapacha.

stages.text_en: Demand rises before festive seasons; monitor DAES prices to time sales for the best return.
stages.text_sw: Mahitaji huongezeka karibu na sikukuu; fuatilia bei za DAES kupanga wakati mzuri wa kuuza.

summary_en: Raised alongside goats by many Ilemela households for meat.
summary_sw: Hufugwa pamoja na mbuzi na kaya nyingi za Ilemela kwa ajili ya nyama.

stages.text_en: Provide a dry, well-ventilated pen with enough space to prevent overcrowding and disease spread.
stages.text_sw: Andaa zizi kavu lenye hewa ya kutosha na nafasi ya kutosha kuzuia msongamano na kuenea kwa magonjwa.

stages.text_en: Choose sturdy, active animals from a trusted source and separate new arrivals during quarantine.
stages.text_sw: Chagua wanyama imara na wenye nguvu kutoka chanzo kinachoaminika na watenganishe wapya kwa muda wa tenga.

stages.text_en: Combine grazing with supplementary feed during dry spells, and vaccinate against common regional diseases.
stages.text_sw: Changanya kuchunga na chakula cha ziada wakati wa kiangazi, na chanja dhidi ya magonjwa ya kawaida ya eneo.

stages.text_en: Breed ewes at around 8-10 months; pregnancy lasts about 5 months.
stages.text_sw: Zalisha kondoo jike wakiwa na miezi 8-10; ujauzito huchukua takribani miezi 5.

stages.text_en: Check DAES prices ahead of religious festivals when demand and prices typically rise.
stages.text_sw: Angalia bei za DAES kabla ya sikukuu za kidini ambapo mahitaji na bei huwa juu.

summary_en: Well suited to the wetter plots near Ilemela's water sources.
summary_sw: Anafaa vizuri maeneo yenye unyevu karibu na vyanzo vya maji Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Provide a simple shelter with access to a pond or water trough, since ducks need water for feeding and comfort.
stages.text_sw: Andaa banda rahisi lenye njia ya kufikia bwawa au chombo cha maji, kwani bata wanahitaji maji kwa kula na kustarehe.

stages.text_en: Source healthy day-old ducklings and brood them at a warm, draft-free temperature for the first two weeks.
stages.text_sw: Pata vifaranga vya bata wenye afya wa siku moja na uwaweke sehemu yenye joto na isiyo na upepo wiki mbili za kwanza.

stages.text_en: Feed a mix of grains, greens and access to natural forage in water, and keep the pen clean to control parasites.
stages.text_sw: Lisha mchanganyiko wa nafaka, majani na malisho ya asili majini, na weka banda safi kudhibiti minyoo.

stages.text_en: Collect eggs daily if kept for laying, and monitor growth for meat ducks toward 8-10 weeks.
stages.text_sw: Kusanya mayai kila siku kama wanafugwa kwa mayai, na fuatilia ukuaji wa bata wa nyama hadi wiki 8-10.

stages.text_en: Ducks fetch good prices around festive periods; compare DAES prices before selling.
stages.text_sw: Bata huuzwa vizuri karibu na sikukuu; linganisha bei za DAES kabla ya kuuza.

summary_en: A key Lake Victoria fish species central to Mwanza's fishing economy.
summary_sw: Aina muhimu ya samaki wa Ziwa Victoria, kiini cha uchumi wa uvuvi Mwanza.

stages.text_en: For cage culture, site cages in well-oxygenated, current-flowing water away from pollution sources.
stages.text_sw: Kwa ufugaji wa vizimba, weka vizimba mahali penye oksijeni ya kutosha na mkondo wa maji, mbali na uchafuzi.

stages.text_en: Stock healthy fingerlings at the recommended density for your cage or pond size.
stages.text_sw: Weka vifaranga wenye afya kwa msongamano unaoshauriwa kulingana na ukubwa wa zizi au bwawa.

stages.text_en: Feed a protein-rich floating or sinking feed on a regular schedule, and monitor water quality closely.
stages.text_sw: Lisha chakula chenye protini ya kutosha kwa ratiba ya kawaida, na fuatilia ubora wa maji kwa karibu.

stages.text_en: Sample-weigh periodically to track growth and adjust feeding rates.
stages.text_sw: Pima sampuli mara kwa mara kufuatilia ukuaji na kurekebisha kiwango cha chakula.

stages.text_en: Harvest at market size, keep on ice immediately to preserve quality, and check DAES prices at Mwanza landing sites.
stages.text_sw: Vuna wakiwa na ukubwa wa soko, weka barafuni mara moja kudumisha ubora, na angalia bei za DAES katika vituo vya kutua Mwanza.

summary_en: A popular, fast-growing fish for both lake fishing and pond farming near Ilemela.
summary_sw: Samaki maarufu anayekua haraka, huvuliwa ziwani na kufugwa mabwawani karibu na Ilemela.

stages.text_en: Dry and lime the pond bed, then fill with clean water and allow algae to establish before stocking.
stages.text_sw: Kausha na wekea chokaa sakafu ya bwawa, kisha jaza maji safi na ruhusu mwani kuota kabla ya kuweka samaki.

stages.text_en: Stock same-sex or sex-reversed fingerlings to control unwanted breeding and overcrowding.
stages.text_sw: Weka vifaranga wa jinsia moja au waliobadilishwa jinsia kudhibiti uzazi usiohitajika na msongamano.

stages.text_en: Feed a balanced pellet feed 2-3 times daily and monitor water colour and oxygen levels.
stages.text_sw: Lisha chakula bora mara 2-3 kwa siku na fuatilia rangi ya maji na kiwango cha oksijeni.

stages.text_en: Sample-weigh monthly and adjust feed amounts as fish grow toward harvest size.
stages.text_sw: Pima sampuli kila mwezi na rekebisha kiasi cha chakula samaki wanavyokua kuelekea ukubwa wa mavuno.

stages.text_en: Harvest at 250-400g, keep fresh on ice for local sale, and compare DAES market prices before selling.
stages.text_sw: Vuna wakiwa na gramu 250-400, weka mbichi barafuni kwa uuzaji wa hapa hapa, na linganisha bei za DAES kabla ya kuuza.
